name: The Daylight in the Darkness
source:
The protagonist finds himself in a world where he meets a lot of girls. He realizes that there is a struggle between factions in the world to rule and exist. The hero discovers that he is easily able to use magic and its possibilities. And perhaps with his power he can turn the game around or set up his own harem and be happy

He faces many mysteries, but one thing he knows for sure: he needs answers to many questions about what happened to him in such a short time

Dive into this mysterious adventure in a new world!

[From [url=https://igro-00.itch.io/daylight-in-the-darkness]Itch.io[/url]]
